scope: Multi-node-capable code validated locally; no physical X203 cross-node run or full-domain scaling result

runs.command: .venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_fann_ddp tests.test_fann_formal tests.test_fann_startup_cache tests.test_fann_speed tests.test_fann_adapters tests.test_fann_bounded_graphs

gpu_evidence.scope: Two torchrun node agents with NCCL on two RTX3090 GPUs on ONE physical host; not an X203 inter-node network test

invariants: Each train case once per epoch; no padded data repeats or dropped tail
Global gradient agrees with node-weighted reference on unequal-size cases
DDP frozen validation/test metrics agree with single-process frozen evaluation
Same-world interrupted resume exactly restores CPU weights, Adam and history
Existing single-process checkpoint imports without state key changes
Shared stop request saves state; active run lock remains protected
limitations: GPU smoke fixtures are small, not the 9.8-million-node production dataset
Two torchrun agents were tested on one physical host
X203 distributed backend, inter-node networking, capacity and throughput require cluster preflight
Global batch changes with world size; LR is not automatically scaled
UNet uses local BatchNorm and rank0 buffer broadcasts, not SyncBatchNorm
